content.short: Sequence is a plug-and-play web3 suite of tools for easily building user-friendly dapps.
content.description: Blockchain applications often struggle with a user experience that is hard to navigate for users without a crypto background. Sequence provides the Sequence SDK with plug-in features designed to streamline this experience, including gasless transactions, batched transactions, and embeddable wallet solutions that can be customized to look and feel like your application. It's easy to integrate into your existing dapp, helping developers deliver a smoother, more welcoming UX for their users without major rewrites.
